defs.def: the world; the planet that we live on 世界；地球

ex.s: Disappearance of the Earth’s smells can be a cultural loss.
ex.t: 地球气味的消失可能是一种文化上的损失。

ex.s: In the race to document the species on Earth before they go extinct, researchers and citizen scientists have collected billions of records.
ex.t: 在赶在物种灭绝前记录地球物种的竞赛中，研究人员和公民科学家已收集了数十亿条记录。

ex.s: “Life on Earth is kind of a box of spare parts for the inventor,” he says.
ex.t: 地球上的生命对发明家来说有点像一盒备件，他说。
地球上的生命是多样的。

ex.s: The only system known to exhibit this is Earth’s biosphere.
ex.t: 已知唯一能展示这种能力的系统是地球的生物圈。

ex.s: Indeed, it is thought that over four- fifths of living species on earth remain undiscovered.
ex.t: 事实上，据认为地球上超过五分之四的物种仍未被发现。

ex.s: Familiar examples include Earth as the center of the universe and the stability of continents.
ex.t: 熟悉的例子包括地球是宇宙中心以及大陆稳定不变的观点。

ex.s: New ways of measuring time can help to control Earth systems．
ex.t: 测量时间的新方法可以帮助控制地球系统。

ex.s: Because the moon’s body blocks direct radio communication with a probe, China first had to put a satellite in orbit above the moon in a spot   63   it could send signals to the spacecraft and to Earth.
ex.t: 由于月球本体阻挡了与探测器的直接无线电通信，中国必须先在月球上方轨道上的一个___63___能将信号发往航天器和地球的位置部署一颗卫星。

ex.s: You couldn’t have dragged Jimmy out of New York; he thought it was the only place on earth.
ex.t: 你不可能把吉米拖出纽约的；他认为那是世界上唯一值得待的地方。

ex.s: You couldn't have dragged Jimmy out of New York; he thought it was the only place on earth.
ex.t: 你不可能把吉米拖出纽约的；他以为那是世界上唯一值得待的地方。

ex.s: The Time Machine A faint blue light shot across it, darkening to purple, and presently she could see the image of her son, who lived on the other side of the earth, and he could see her.
ex.t: 《时间机器》 一道微弱的蓝光划过，渐渐暗成了紫色，不一会儿她就看到了儿子的影像——他住在地球的另一边，而他也能看到她。

ex.s: The Machine Stops Instead of being printed, the Earth Chronicle is every morning spoken to subscribers, who, in interesting conversations with reporters, statesmen, and scientists, learn the news of the day.
ex.t: 《机器停止》：地球纪事不再印刷，而是每天早上通过有趣的对话向订阅者播报，订阅者通过与记者、政治家和科学家的交流了解当天的新闻。

ex.s: This broadcast is being brought to you from the largest museum on Earth -- the Louvre!
ex.t: 本次直播从地球上最大的博物馆——卢浮宫——为您呈现！

ex.s: In our society, we know that Earth has only one moon.
ex.t: 在我们的社会中，我们知道地球只有一颗卫星。

ex.s: Earth Day，  4  （mark）on 22 April，is an annual event aiming to raise public awareness about environmental protection.
ex.t: 地球日，于4月22日___4___（mark），是一项旨在提高公众环保意识的年度活动。

ex.s: No matter what you like to do，there is a way to get involved in various   6  （activity） on Earth Day.
ex.t: 无论你喜欢做什么，在地球日都有办法参与各种____6____（活动）。

ex.s: Increasing Earth’s reflectiveness can cool the planet.
ex.t: 增加地球的反射率可以使地球降温。

ex.s: Microplastics have become a common source of pollution across the Earth — they have settled in the deep sea and on the Himalayas, stuck inside volcanic rocks, filled the stomachs of seabirds and even fallen in fresh Antarctic snow.
ex.t: 微塑料已成为全球普遍的污染源——它们沉积在深海和喜马拉雅山上，卡在火山岩中，填满海鸟的胃，甚至落在南极的新鲜积雪里。

defs.def: land; the hard surface of the world that is not the sea or the sky; the ground 陆地；地面；大地
the substance that plants grow in 土；泥；泥土
the hole where an animal, especially a fox, lives 兽穴；（尤指狐狸栖息的）洞穴
a wire that connects an electric circuit with the ground and makes it safe （接）地线
